title: The feud with Red Allen
summary: Mosley did not like Red's playing after hearing Peanuts and they had a feud.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Red got to be a hellion
later, but Red was playing allright, but he didn't play no great music with that band. I didn't like his playing.
I had been listening to guys like Peanuts Harland--
You were used to something different.
And then Louie, I mean after all, when you had Louie, it was something different.
But to listen to somebody--I mean Louie can't be compared with anybody-- but after listening to guys like--
Red's disposition would affect the way you'd listen.
We had a feud going, he and I.
